title: Partition Array for Maximum Sum
summary: Given an integer array arr, partition it into contiguous subarrays such that each subarray's length is at most k.
statement: Given an integer array arr, partition it into contiguous subarrays such that each subarray's length is at most k. Replace each element in a subarray with the maximum value of that subarray. Return the maximum possible sum of the array after performing the partitioning.
constraints: Values are nonnegative and every partition length is at most k.
Replace a partition by its maximum repeated across its length.
hints: Let dp[end] be the best result for the prefix ending before end.
Try every final partition size up to k while maintaining its maximum.
Every valid partitioning has exactly one final segment considered by this recurrence.
editorial: Every valid partitioning has exactly one final segment considered by this recurrence.

tests.explanation: The only one-element partition retains value one.
